9ece182f5a: Get Help with Genoryn Krypton: Wallet, Mining, Swaps and Nodes
a03baf7b79: Something does not work, or you are not sure how it should. Most questions are answered in a minute by the pages below. If yours is not, here is where to ask, and how to ask so that someone can answer.
610a1416bd: <0>Nobody who helps you needs your 24 words, your password or your wallet file. Ever.</0> Nobody from the project will write to you first, ask you to install a "support tool", to share your screen, or to send coins to "verify" a wallet. Whoever does is trying to rob you.
f607b7dbd4: Short answers: what GNR is, how it resists quantum computers, what is private, mining, swaps, fees, who controls it.
ed24741fe5: The wallet does not connect, the miner stops, a payment is pending, a swap waits. What each one means and what to do.
31e1286018: Everything in one place: the wallet tab by tab, backup, mining, swaps, running a node, the API.
2d7e8aa105: Installing on Linux, Windows and macOS, opening the port, tuning, and what to do when it does not sync.
f742887408: How to start, how rewards are shared, when they are paid, and what your hashrate earns.
5c2eacaf50: It may be fixed already. Every release says what changed.
d79f63a7f9: The 24 words restore the wallet without it: add a wallet, choose <0>Restore from recovery phrase</0> and set a new password. Without the words and without the password, nobody can open the wallet, the project included.
da4742fd94: If you can still open the wallet, show them again under <0>Security</0> and write them down now. If you cannot, there is nothing anyone can do.
31f4cd79a5: It waits for the next block, usually within a minute or two. If it stays, check that the wallet is connected (the badge at the top says <0>verified</0>).
7637b408e5: My swap says the GNR is locked and nothing happens.
49fd39a1e4: It is not lost. If the buyer never pays, the GNR comes back by itself at the block the swap shows, about 21 hours after the lock. Keep the wallet running then.
c576b551d4: My mining rewards are not in my balance.
a88a5ad84d: Rewards build up and are paid as one note every 360 blocks, about six hours, and can be spent 100 blocks later. The Mining tab shows what is building up.
18f05c619d: <0>About → Check for updates</0>. The newest release is always at the top of <1>News</1>.
f7e55a0335: Ask the community on <0><1>Genoryn Talks</1></0>, the forum and live chat of Genoryn Krypton: a name and a password are enough to join. Problems with the software go to its issue tracker on GitHub, which is open to read without an account; to write there you need a free GitHub account, which needs no real name.
27a8732a4b: Choose <0>Question</0>. Someone who knows will answer in public, so the next person with the same question finds it.
e75a804274: Something is broken rather than unclear. How to report it so that it can be found and fixed.
7043bf1157: If what you found could cost people their coins or their privacy, tell the project privately, never in public.
7596df4160: What to put in your question
4bfee6f730: The <0>version</0>: the wallet's About tab, or <1/>.
aef79e7f39: Your <0>system</0>: Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04, and for mining the graphics card.
5271f8c610: What you <0>did</0>, what you <1>expected</1> and what you <2>saw</2>, with the exact words of any error.
53911c3e2b: Transaction and block ids are public and fine to post. Addresses are yours to share or not.
ad0d5f7d6d: The wallet's <0>Console</0> can gather some of this for you: <1/>, <2/> and <3/> show the version, how the wallet is connected and where the chain stands. None of them shows a key or a balance.
8cdc32b08e: Genoryn Krypton has no support department. The people who answer are people who use it. If you have run a miner for a week or set up a node, you already know things a newcomer is stuck on.
b84ce4a0c3: <0>Answer questions.</0> Open questions are <1>listed here</1>. Say what worked for you, and say when you are not sure.
cb7dd54002: <0>Confirm bugs.</0> "It happens for me too, on this system and this version" turns one report into a pattern.
9cc361a9a0: <0>Point to the page.</0> If the answer is in the documentation, link it. If it is not there, that is a gap worth <1>filling</1>.
a74489afab: <0>Never ask for, and never accept,</0> anybody's recovery phrase, password or wallet file, and say so when you see someone else ask.
